journeys.notes: Editing and live word counting worked, but the saved note did not persist after reload.

findings.observed: After entering "meeting notes: ship Friday" and clicking Save, reloading the Notes page restored the textbox to "hello world". The page also did not show the documented "Saved ✓" status.
findings.expected_basis: The original purpose requires a user to write and save a note; app/README.md states that Save persists the note and shows "Saved ✓".
findings.reproduction: 1. Open http://127.0.0.1:8907/. 2. Replace the note with "meeting notes: ship Friday". 3. Click Save. 4. Reload the page. 5. Observe that the textbox contains "hello world" instead of the entered note.

notes: The Notes page and live word-count behavior were observed through an isolated agent-browser session. Console and page-error checks returned no output.
